description: This Java class 'NormalizedMessageMapper' implements a message mapper for normalized changes. It converts create- and modify-events into nested sparse JSON structures, while dropping other signals. The class extends 'AbstractMessageMapper' and provides methods to configure mappings, and to map incoming external messages or adaptable objects into external messages following specific transformation logic.

classes.name: NormalizedMessageMapper
classes.description: A Java class implementing a message mapper for normalized create and modify events, transforming them into nested JSON messages. It handles configuration, determines if an event qualifies as a create/modify event, and performs the transformation into ExternalMessage instances.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this mapper, which is 'normalized'.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper based on provided mapping configuration, setting the JSON field selector if specified.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Overloaded method: one processes ExternalMessage objects (returns empty list as all are dropped), another processes Adaptable objects, converting create/modify events into ExternalMessages.

methods.name: flattenAsThingChange
methods.description: Transforms an Adaptable representing a create or modify event into an ExternalMessage with a nested JSON representation.

methods.name: abridgeMessage
methods.description: Creates a summary JSON object from an Adaptable, including topic, path, fields, and headers, omitting value and status.

methods.name: dittoHeadersToJson
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders entries into a JSON object.

methods.name: isCreatedOrModifiedThingEvent
methods.description: Checks if the TopicPath corresponds to a create or modify event in the 'things' group.
